correctness.rationale: Shafi–Tschanz v1 Theorem 3.3.1 gives the five listed counts for the dual complex of the cube special fibre. One open cell per simplex gives 21−120+420−480+192=33. The standard CW structure on CP² has one cell in each of dimensions 0, 2, and 4, yielding 3; homeomorphism would preserve that invariant. Remark 3.1.2 says the computations ‘should give triangulations of CP²’; it does not independently prove that this particular stack model meets the hypotheses of the cited topological theorem. The result is correct as an incompatibility of the reported f-vector with that expectation, not as a determination of the true dual complex or as a refutation of the conditional topological theorem.
residual_risks: No geometric stratum census, corrected face vector, or verification of the hypotheses on the stack model is supplied or needed for the incompatibility.
